name: Veiled Ascension
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, put a flying counter on each face-down creature you control.
Face-down creatures you control enter with a flying counter on them.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may cloak the top card of your library.
blocked_sentences: Face-down creatures you control enter with a flying counter on them.

needs.what: `face_down: true` accepted in a static's `affects` filter (STATIC_AFFECTS_FILTER_KEYS), so the `enters_with_additional_counters` static can be written as {"affects": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "face_down": true}, "counter": "flying", "amount": 1}; the arrival must be matched after zones._enter_battlefield marks it face down (708.2), i.e. the static's `_matches` must see obj.face_down set for a morph/manifest/cloak arrival
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `enters_with_additional_counters` is the right static (614.1c arrival counters, a flying counter is a 122.1c keyword counter), but `face_down` is only a selector and trigger-filter key; the loader refuses it in a static `affects` (cards/loader/__init__.py checks STATIC_AFFECTS_FILTER_KEYS, which lacks it). Without it the static would put flying counters on every creature you control. A `permanent_enters` trigger filtered on face_down running add_counters is respondable and lets the creature enter without the counter, so it is a different card. The other two lines are expressible (self_enters add_counters with objects face_down true; upkeep may + manifest with cloak: true)
